summary: Calabrian judge from Conflenti murdered by the 'Ndrangheta in 1975; shares the Ferlaino surname of John's San Mango family, with no proven kinship.
bio:
Francesco Ferlaino was born on 23 July 1914 at Conflenti, the comune next to San Mango d'Aquino. He became an investigating judge and later president of an appeals court. On 3 July 1975 he was shot dead by the 'Ndrangheta near his home in Nicastro, now part of Lamezia Terme; President Mattarella later commemorated him. He was the paternal uncle of Corrado Ferlaino, the owner of SSC Napoli.

Ferlaino is a small surname of the Savuto valley, so a distant link to John's Ferlaino ancestors of San Mango is plausible, but none has been proven.
